description: This file defines the interface and implementation for a Timer class and a TimerFactory class within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and necessary includes for timer functionality, including creation, cancellation, and status checking of timers.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Timer instances, implementing the ITimerFactory interface.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class implementing the ITimer interface, representing a timer with start, cancel, and status functionalities.

methods.name: createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new Timer instance with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently active.
